annotation.title_clean: Guidelines 03/2026 on web scraping in the context of generative AI training
annotation.title_en: Guidelines 03/2026 on web scraping in the context of generative AI training
annotation.summary_en: EDPB guidelines (v1.0, for public consultation) on applying the GDPR to web scraping by private entities for training generative AI. They cover controller roles, transparency, data minimisation, accuracy, legitimate interest balancing with mitigating measures, and special-category data. They contain no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: GDPR applies to web scraping that processes personal data; controller/processor roles are assessed case by case.
Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) needs three cumulative conditions; consent is unlikely to be workable.
Data minimisation measures: precise collection criteria, filters, excluding sites that oppose scraping (robots.txt, CAPTCHA), synthetic data.
Art. 14(5)(b) exception for informing individuals is limited; controllers must publish scraping information publicly.
Incidental collection of special-category data may be tolerated under C-136/17 only with strong prevention and deletion measures.
